pages.text: The management panel is the interaction core of the mod.$(br2)Open the panel: By default, press V to open. The state is shown below.

Basic Operations:$(br2)Interaction: Aim at a mage or building to see a white bounding box. Right-click to open its details page.$(br2)Switch Modes: Press 1, 2, 3, 4 to switch sub-modes on the left:$(br2)1→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_build_guide)《Build Mode》$(/l): Construct buildings

2→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_road_guide)《Road Mode》$(/l): Pave roads and shape terrain$(br2)3→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_tasks_guide)《Task Hall》$(/l): Manage tasks and mage status$(br2)4→$(l:wandscape:management/panel_settings_guide)《Settings》$(/l): Modify mod settings
